title: Agent activity event (summary tier)
description: One normalized event of an agent session, from any runtime (a coding CLI on a workstation or in the cloud, an orchestrator, a generic pusher): the public summary tier of the status hub's agent activity (ADR-0013 stage 1b, docs/status.md). It names things and counts things; it never carries a prompt, a command, a tool input or output or an approval payload -- those live only in the private detail tier (agent_activity_detail.schema.json), which never goes on the shared bus. It is also the data of the homelabnext.agent.activity event. Evolve additively.

event_id.description: Unique per event; a re-sent event is a duplicate.

parent_session_id.description: The session that started this one (a subagent, a delegated task).

runtime.description: What runs the agent: claude-code, codex, hermes, orchestrator, agentmetry, generic, ...

surface.description: Where the session runs: a lab or workstation host, or a cloud session.

project.description: The project or repository name (never a path).

kind.description: stop: the agent finished its turn and waits for the operator; session_end: the session is over.

tool.description: The tool's NAME only, never its input.

cost_usd.description: Only when the runtime reports it.

has_detail.description: A private detail record exists for this event.
